card.name: Linking words after patient population nouns
card.fires_on: Small linking words or spaces right after a study population such as patients, adults or a disorder name, before a diagnosis or age group. Seen in clinical study and dosing text for psychiatric drugs.

modes.label: Before a diagnosis
modes.description: The word with or in after patients or adults, leading into a condition such as MDD, bipolar mania or schizophrenia.

modes.description: The space after patients, before an age such as 1 year and older or 17 years of age and older.

modes.label: After a disorder or study name
modes.description: The word in or an opening parenthesis after a disorder name or maintenance study, before a population or subtype.
